The '''sea caves''' were a network of submersed [[Cave/Legends|caves]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]]. During the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the dropping [[Water/Legends|sea]] levels revealed the long-hidden caves that had been occupied [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] before. Eventually, someone was sent to investigate them, discovering that the caves had been used by the native [[Species/Legends|species]] to hide from [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and their possessions could still be found inside the caves.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Sea Caves of Iskalon}}</ref>
